name: Global Uniques
uniques: Land units may cross [{your} {Mountain}] tiles after the first [Land] is earned <for [Personnel] units> <in [{your} {Mountain Complex}] tiles>

Can pass through impassable tiles <for [Land] units> <in [{your} {Mountain Complex}] tiles>
Can pass through impassable tiles <for [Land] units> <in [{your} {Tunnels} {Mountain}] tiles> <in tiles adjacent to [{your} {Mountain Complex}] tiles>
Cannot attack <when fighting in [Tunnels] tiles> <vs [Personnel] units>
Can only heal by pillaging <in [{Tunnels} {non-[Utility Support Systems]}] tiles> <for [Terrestrial] units>
[This Unit] takes [1] damage <upon turn end> <in [non-[Utility Support Systems]] tiles> <for [Terrestrial] units>
Nuclear weapon of Strength [0] <for [Nuclear weapon of Strength] units> <when fighting in [Tunnels] tiles>
Blast radius [0] <for [Nuclear Weapon] units> <when fighting in [Tunnels] tiles>

civilopediaText.text: Global uniques are ruleset-wide modifiers that apply to all civilizations.
